name: N4 Group S.A.
summary: N4 Group S.A. manufactures and distributes sports nutrition, beauty, dietary supplements, and fitness equipment. It retails fitness and sports nutrition equipment, including cardio and strength training equipment and supplements under the FitnessBoutique brand name. It also operates N4 Labs for research and development, formulation, quality, innovation, and industrialization of nutrition products. It retails its products through e-commerce; the FitnessBoutique network in France, Belgium, and Morocco; pharmacies; para pharmacies; specialist retailers; and mass retails.
